Wes Studi | Wesley "Wes" Studi (Cherokee: ᏪᏌ ᏍᏚᏗ ) (born December 17, 1947) is a Cherokee actor and film producer from Nofire Hollow in Oklahoma. The plot revolves around four teenagers who are stalked and killed in their dreams (and thus killed in reality) by Freddy Krueger. She was created by Wes Craven.  The character was portrayed by Amanda Wyss in the original film and Katie Cassidy in the 2010 film. Amanda Wyss | Amanda Wyss (born November 24, 1960) is an American film and television actress.
